==Problem==
Camila writes down five positive integers. The unique mode of these integers is <imath>2</imath> greater than their median, and the median is <imath>2</imath> greater than their arithmetic mean. What is the least possible value for the mode?

<imath>\textbf{(A)}\ 5 \qquad\textbf{(B)}\ 7 \qquad\textbf{(C)}\ 9 \qquad\textbf{(D)}\ 11 \qquad\textbf{(E)}\ 13</imath>

==Solution 1 (Variables)==
Let <imath>M</imath> be the median. It follows that the two largest integers are both <imath>M+2.</imath>

Let <imath>a</imath> and <imath>b</imath> be the two smallest integers such that <imath>a<b.</imath> The sorted list is <cmath>a,b,M,M+2,M+2.</cmath>
Since the median is <imath>2</imath> greater than their arithmetic mean, we have <imath>\frac{a+b+M+(M+2)+(M+2)}{5}+2=M,</imath> or <cmath>a+b+14=2M.</cmath>
Note that <imath>a+b</imath> must be even. We minimize this sum so that the arithmetic mean, the median, and the unique mode are minimized. Let <imath>a=1</imath> and <imath>b=3,</imath> from which <imath>M=9</imath> and <imath>M+2=\boxed{\textbf{(D)}\ 11}.</imath>

~MRENTHUSIASM

==Solution 2 (Elimination)==

We can also easily test all the answer choices. (This strategy is generally good to use for multiple-choice questions if you don't have a concrete method to proceed with!)

For answer choice <imath>\textbf{(A)},</imath> the mode is <imath>5,</imath> the median is <imath>3,</imath> and the arithmetic mean is <imath>1.</imath> However, we can quickly see this doesn't work, as there are five integers, and they can't have an arithmetic mean of <imath>1</imath> while having a mode of <imath>5.</imath> 

Trying answer choice <imath>\textbf{(B)},</imath> the mode is <imath>7,</imath> the median is <imath>5,</imath> and the arithmetic mean is <imath>3.</imath> From the arithmetic mean, we know that all the numbers have to sum to <imath>15.</imath> We know three of the numbers: <imath>\underline{\hspace{3mm}},\underline{\hspace{3mm}},5,7,7.</imath> This exceeds the sum of <imath>15.</imath>

Now we try answer choice <imath>\textbf{(C)}.</imath> The mode is <imath>9,</imath> the median is <imath>7,</imath> and the arithmetic mean is <imath>5.</imath> From the arithmetic mean, we know that the list sums to <imath>25.</imath> Three of the numbers are <imath>\underline{\hspace{3mm}},\underline{\hspace{3mm}},7,9,9,</imath> which is exactly <imath>25.</imath> However, our list needs positive integers, so this won't work.

Since we were really close on answer choice <imath>\textbf{(C)},</imath> we can intuitively feel that the answer is probably going to be <imath>\textbf{(D)}.</imath> We can confirm this by creating a list that satisfies the problem and choose <imath>\textbf{(D)}: 1,3,9,11,11.</imath>

So, our answer is <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(D)}\ 11}.</imath>
